name: status-full-tier-node-backend
description: GET /status?detail=full on the Node coordinator, with the operator opt-in header spelled TRUE: the header's value is matched ignoring case. The operator view is the default body (fixture 09) with the four pattern lists the live policy enforces added to policy_summary, each as written, and nothing else: no pid, no session names, and coordinator_root stays '.'. pre_edit_if_unheld is true, as at every tier. Every top-level key is listed, so a key the view gains or loses fails the row. tracked.yaml, ignored.yaml and strict_mode.yaml each hold user patterns; tracked_patterns and default_pattern_count are the coordinator's own defaults and are ignored here. Node only: the Python coordinator's operator view carries many more keys (fixture 27); fixture 43 pins what both views share.
